question: When will my refund come?
canonical_answer: Refunds to UPI reach you within 1 business day and to cards within 5 to 7 business days. You will get an SMS when it is credited.

question: Why did my UPI payment fail?
canonical_answer: A UPI payment can fail if your daily limit is reached, the bank is temporarily down, or the receiver UPI ID is wrong. Please check the error message and try again after some time.

question: Why did my Rupay payment fail?
canonical_answer: A Rupay payment can fail if the merchant does not accept Rupay, your daily limit is reached, or the issuing bank declines high value transfers at night. Check the error message shown on screen.

question: How do I change the card linked to my account?
canonical_answer: You can change your linked card in the app under Payment Methods. Remove the old card and add the new one. The change takes effect immediately.

question: What are the fees for using UPI?
canonical_answer: UPI payments to merchants and individuals are free for customers. Some wallet loads using a credit card may carry a small fee shown before you confirm.

question: How do I reset my daily transaction limit?
canonical_answer: Your daily transaction limit resets automatically at midnight. To request a higher limit, go to Settings and then Limits in the app and submit a request.

question: When do merchant settlements happen?
canonical_answer: Merchant settlements are processed on the next business day for transactions completed before 11 pm. Settlements over weekends are credited on the following working day.

question: What is the MDR for card transactions?
canonical_answer: The merchant discount rate for card transactions is 0.9 percent for debit cards and 1.8 percent for credit cards, deducted at settlement.

question: How do I set up autopay or a mandate?
canonical_answer: You can set up autopay by approving a mandate in the app. Open Autopay, choose the biller, set the amount and frequency, and approve with your UPI PIN.

question: Which banks are supported for UPI?
canonical_answer: Most major Indian banks are supported for UPI including public and private sector banks. You can see the full list when you link your bank account in the app.
